handshake_program.title: The Handshake - Take the Pill
handshake_program.description: llms have basically given software the ability to actually *get* what humans mean and want. even with just the tools we have right now, we've barely scratched the surface of what's possible with this new kind of software. so we're putting out this open call to all the builders, dreamers, and chaos mages out there.
requirements: Project must use Rig in some way
Token is not required (and won't be penalized if it doesn't have one)
Some doxing will be required for selected projects
benefits: Selected projects building with Solana will be reviewed by the Solana Foundation
Selected projects building with Arbitrum Stylus are eligible for Arbitrum DAO grants
Get added to Arc Registry if selected
Grants, mentorship, and immediate visibility within Arc community

process.step_3: Get added to arc registry if selected
process.step_4: Raise ARC or SOL to create LP pair (from community or yourself, Arc will jump in on special cases)

handshake_program.vision: we're not just building more chatbots. we're looking for ideas that explore how AI can make web3 more intelligent

ryzome.name: Ryzome
ryzome.tagline: your ideas, amplified. one canvas. infinite possibilities.
ryzome.description: Where your knowledge comes alive with AI that understands context and connections. Create powerful AI workflows that solve real problems in minutes, not days.

how_it_works.step_1: Start with your knowledge: Import existing notes or start fresh. Every idea becomes a node on your infinite canvas. Write in markdown, add images, organize visually.
how_it_works.step_2: Connect your thoughts: Draw connections between related ideas. Each link preserves context, building a knowledge graph that mirrors how you actually think.
how_it_works.step_3: Amplify with AI: Every node is ai-powered. Generate new insights, expand concepts, or synthesize connected ideas. The AI understands your entire context chain.

features: Markdown-enabled nodes: Create rich notes with full markdown support
Context-aware AI: Connect nodes to build context chains. AI understands your full thought process
Instant knowledge graphs: Watch your research evolve into living knowledge graphs. See connections, identify patterns, discover insights
ryzome.team: Built by the arc & playgrounds team

problems_solved.description: Needing to stay 'locked in,' staring at charts because you're anticipating an event but don't know exactly when
problems_solved.example: Wait for fartcoin to hit $x market cap, then DCA 30% of bag into pengu unless pengu goes up >10% from now

problems_solved.description: Manually managing portfolios and LP positions across multiple wallets, blockchains, and protocols
problems_solved.example: Use 10k usdc to provide concentrated liquidity for brett on base, use tick spacing multiplier of 5

problems_solved.description: Market and token information is overwhelming, dispersed, and rapidly changing
